- Overestimate prices after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is negative or volatile.  
- Underestimate sharp downward moves when sentiment is strongly negative (e.g., -0.50+).  
- Overreact to short-term sentiment swings; model tends to overcorrect in 30-day horizon.  
- Mean-reversion bias: model often holds prices too high after recent highs, especially if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.  
- Lagged sentiment influence: if sentiment turns negative within 5–7 days, model should adjust downward more aggressively.  
- Avoid over-optimism in bullish sentiment windows; model tends to overpredict upward moves when sentiment is mildly positive.
